why: The briefs catch all three must_catch items. Item 1: builder step 2 has the builder add a "### subtract(a, b)" entry as well as clamp. The brief also flags "subtract is exported but not in the README" and asks that every name in module.exports get its own heading. Item 2: verifier Check 3 runs a node command at the head that lists the exported functions. It says "At minimum this includes add, subtract, multiply and clamp" and gives "FAIL: any exported function is not documented in README.md". It also points out that subtract was undocumented before. Item 3: verifier Check 2 calls clamp with lo > hi ([5,10,0], [0,1,-1], [50,100,0]) and tests `e instanceof RangeError`. Any other error prints "OTHER ...", and that is a FAIL.
